name: spartan
summary: Angular port of shadcn/ui: 55+ accessible headless primitives plus copy-paste styled components, added by CLI.
description: spartan/ui brings the shadcn/ui approach to Angular: accessible, un-styled primitives published as @spartan-ng/brain, paired with shadcn-style helm components that the @spartan-ng/cli copies into a workspace so you own the code. Ships 55+ components plus theming, blocks, typography, RTL and Figma docs, an MCP server (@spartan-ng/mcp) and an agent skill for AI assistants. The monorepo also holds spartan/stack, a full-stack example on AnalogJS, Supabase, Drizzle and tRPC. MIT licensed.
contains: headless primitives in @spartan-ng/brain; styled helm components copied by the CLI
@spartan-ng/cli Nx plugin and Angular schematics add it to any workspace
@spartan-ng/mcp provides spartan docs to AI assistants; agent skill via npx skills add
docs cover theming, styles, dark mode, RTL, typography, Figma and blocks
spartan/stack: AnalogJS, Supabase, Drizzle, tRPC, Tailwind, Nx example app
